reason: The historical base commit is unavailable in checked local repositories and GitHub; the dictionary was recovered exactly, but three successful recovery builds differ from the trusted exporter hash.
required_before_probe_use: Use a separately named research exporter identity that truthfully records the available source commit; do not stamp the unavailable historical HEAD onto a new artifact.
Freeze source code, exact dependencies, toolchain, instrumentation, build recipe and source/tree hashes before compilation; record MSVC linker and SDK provenance too.
Build in two independent archive directories without git worktrees; require identical executable hashes and explicit success/timeout/failure receipts.

Select and commit a maximum of 100 legacy train request IDs by SHA-256 of canonical JSON [20261104, stable_id] before reading candidate contents. Select only from authenticated train membership; never use dev or final holdout.

Compare all selected legacy candidate outputs field by field: ranks, surfaces, signed costs, fingerprints, segment offsets/IDs/flags/source categories, terminal status, full-reading Top-32 and Top-6 prefix. Differences in provenance must be separately declared, never erased to manufacture historical identity.
A matching finite regression sample does not prove global historical parity. Describe the result as a newly verified research reference, not recovery of the old binary.

Keep the legacy validators and allowlist unchanged. A separate, hash-bound probe validator must reject unverified or substituted identities and must not make records eligible for legacy training or Gold admission.
stop_conditions: Any missing source identity, source mutation, nondeterministic build or legacy candidate disagreement stops promotion to probe use; preserve the reason and exact denominator.
Do not change labels, model weights, thresholds, production code, installer contents, defaults or final-Test consumption to resolve a tooling failure.
expected_effect: Restore the ability to measure candidate coverage on independently annotated readings with an explicit, reproducible source identity.
cost: Two bounded builds, at most 100 fixed train regression requests, two executions of the existing 50-request probe, focused contracts and the full unit suite; not a label-quality certificate.
